# ELKAY Enterprise Limited

> Nairobi-based manufacturer and supplier of bakery ingredients: bakers fat and pan grease. KEBS and Halal certified. In operation since 2023 and supplying more than 60 bakeries and supermarket bakeries across Kenya. Tagline: "A baker's friend".

## Products and prices (KES, negotiable for bigger volumes)

- ELKAY Bakers Fat: KSh 2,300 per 10 kg box. Emulsified fat for bread, buns, scones and other yeast products. Use at 2% of flour weight (2 kg per 100 kg of flour). Holds moisture longer so bakes stay softer and fresher. Shelf life 12 months.
- ELKAY Pan Grease: KSh 3,800 per 20-litre jerrican. Vegetable-oil release agent for bread tins and baking trays. Apply a thin coat on clean tins. No sticking, no smoke, tins stay free of debris. Vegan.
- Coming soon: Cake gel (cake emulsifier) and flavours and essences.

## Ordering

- Orders are placed by phone only (the number is on https://elkaykenya.com/).
- Customers choose delivery or collection. Shipping costs may apply to deliveries.
- Big discounts are available on larger volumes and regular monthly orders.

## Customers include

Festive Bread, Yami Premium Bread, Bounty Supermarket, Galmart Supermarket, Cleanshelf, Muhindi Mweusi, EastMatt, K-matt Supermarket, Destiny Best Supermarket, Bella Luna Kitchen.
